failure_modes.name: miniaturized_instrument_slip
failure_modes.symptoms: instrument slip during tissue manipulation; loss of grip precision; unexpected tissue movement
failure_modes.mitigation: tip surface coating; grip-force feedback; instrument replacement schedule; surgeon override

failure_modes.name: battery_depletion_mid_procedure
failure_modes.symptoms: sudden power loss; low-battery warning; reduced actuator torque; emergency shutdown
failure_modes.mitigation: pre-op battery check; redundant power cell; hot-swap battery bay; procedure-time limit

failure_modes.name: imaging_fiber_breakage
failure_modes.symptoms: image degradation; fiberoptic break; dark spots in view; loss of depth perception
failure_modes.mitigation: fiber strain relief; pre-op imaging check; redundant imaging; scope replacement

failure_modes.name: sterilization_cycle_fatigue
failure_modes.symptoms: housing micro-cracks; seal degradation; discoloration; joint stiffness after autoclave
failure_modes.mitigation: cycle-count tracking; seal replacement schedule; single-use sheath option; material upgrade
